name: @pipeworx/mcp-artic

tools.name: search_artworks
tools.description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection by keyword. Returns artwork titles, artists, dates, mediums, and image IDs. Use get_artwork to fetch full details.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default 10)

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Get complete details for an artwork by ID. Returns title, artist, date, medium, dimensions, description, credit line, and high-resolution image.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Get an artist's biography and their artworks by ID. Returns name, birth/death dates, bio text, and linked artwork IDs.

tools.name: get_exhibitions
tools.description: Browse current and past exhibitions at the Art Institute. Returns exhibition titles, descriptions, and status (active or closed).

limit.description: Number of exhibitions to return (1-100, default 10)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-artic forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the artic pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
